name: Agent Hospital
description: Agent Hospital is a simulacrum of a hospital environment where all patients, nurses, and doctors are autonomous agents powered by large language models. It simulates the entire treatment process and enables doctor agents to evolve by treating many patient agents, outperforming state-of-the-art medical agents on the MedQA benchmark.
reputation: A recent research benchmark from the Agent Hospital paper that has drawn attention for its novel autonomous multi-agent medical simulation, but it is not yet a widely established community standard.
notes: Simulates hospital treatment processes with LLM-powered agents and enables agent evolution without manual data labeling.
